descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a Test Analyst to join our team working together with colleagues from France. Your role is to design, develop, maintain, and support consumer credit subscription applications used by customers of our retail and home improvement partners, is seeking an experienced Functional & Integration Tester to join its testing team.
 What you will do: 
Define various testing strategies, including manual and API testing
Create and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts
Maintain test data sets
Perform functional and technical testing to identify defects and anomalies and ensure the quality of applications and systems
Set up and execute regression testing
Ensure defect reporting and follow-up
Ensure the quality of user stories and acceptance criteria
Collaborate with development and production teams to identify and resolve issues
Contribute to the preparation of test reports and testing documentation
Ensure compliance with testing standards and procedures
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to user story elaboration
Work closely with other testing team members to share knowledge and best practice
 What you must have: 
Functional and technical testing
Knowledge of testing tools and programming/scripting languages
Fluent French
Functional knowledge of the consumer credits domain is a plus
Minimum of 4 years of experience in software testing
Knowledge of Agile testing methodologies
Experience with testing tools such as Octane, Jira, and Postman/Bruno
Knowledge of programming languages such as Java
Knowledge of testing standards and methodologies (ISTQB etc.)
Ability to work effectively within a team and communicate clearly and efficiently
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
